_doc: Aliases and ASR misspellings per person in index/people.md, keyed by the stable person slug. Used by scripts/extract_moments.py to find where each person is discussed. `notes` are disambiguation hints for the judge.

david-sacks.notes: Not David the host (the user, David Bloomin). Only count the investor/All-In co-host/White House AI and crypto czar.

marc-andreessen.notes: a16z mentions count only if Andreessen himself is the subject.

ben-horowitz.notes: Not David Horowitz (Ben's father) unless the discussion is about Ben.

elon-musk.notes: DOGE mentions count only when Musk himself is the subject.

chamath-palihapitiya.notes: ASR often renders Chamath as DeMuth / Dimoth / DeMoth.

nancy-pelosi.notes: Christine Pelosi (her daughter) is a different person; segments about Christine do not count for Nancy unless Nancy herself is discussed.

chan.name: Connie Chan
chan.notes: Connie Chan, the San Francisco supervisor Nancy Pelosi backed over Scott Wiener. 'Connie' in the transcript is this Connie Chan, NOT Christine Pelosi.

bari-weiss.notes: Free Press mentions count only when Weiss or her outlet is the subject.

zohran-mamdani.notes: ASR often renders Mamdani as Madani.

christine-pelosi.notes: Nancy Pelosi's daughter, a candidate for the California State Senate seat Scott Wiener is leaving. Not Connie Chan, and not Nancy herself.

ian-choudri.notes: CEO of the California High-Speed Rail Authority.

dave-regan.notes: President of SEIU-United Healthcare Workers West (SEIU-UHW).

saez-and-zucman.name: Emmanuel Saez & Gabriel Zucman
saez-and-zucman.notes: UC Berkeley economists and architects of Prop 40.
